packages.name: purrdf-python
packages.description: Python bindings for PurRDF, packaged as the purrdf_native extension module

packages.name: purrdf
packages.description: PurRDF umbrella crate: RDF 1.2 implementation, slices, and SHACL/ShEx shape validation

packages.name: purrdf-columnar
packages.description: PurRDF's byte-deterministic, bidirectional five-table Parquet codec for RDF 1.2 datasets

packages.name: purrdf-core
packages.license: (MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR MulanPSL-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0
packages.description: PurRDF RDF 1.2 kernel: model, diagnostics, IR, store traits, and event ingestion

packages.name: purrdf-cdt
packages.description: Native SPARQL composite datatypes (SEP-0009 cdt:List / cdt:Map): iterative bounded lexical scanner, canonical lexical mapping, spec equality/ordering and a total order, for the RDF 1.2 query stack

packages.name: purrdf-events
packages.description: Permissive RDF 1.2 ingestion protocol: the object-safe event sink/source seam both the GTS container and the IR engine depend ON

packages.name: purrdf-hash
packages.description: Native, zero-dependency hashing for PurRDF: BLAKE3, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-3/Keccak and CRC-32 digests, streaming and one-shot, the base16 codec and 32-byte digest value, the fixed-key table hasher, FNV-1a and SplitMix64

packages.name: purrdf-alloc-probe
packages.description: The workspace's shared counting allocator and its two measurement windows: per-thread for concurrent test binaries, whole-process for rayon-parallel phases, reporting allocation count, requested bytes, retained bytes and peak live bytes separately

packages.name: purrdf-iri
packages.license: (MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR MulanPSL-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0
packages.description: Native IRI/URI value space (RFC-3987 IRI + RFC-3986 URI parse/validate, reference resolution, syntax normalization, CURIE/prefix expansion) for the RDF 1.2 query stack

packages.name: purrdf-lex
packages.license: (MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR MulanPSL-2.0) AND MIT AND Unicode-3.0 AND BSD-3-Clause
packages.description: Native lexical foundations for PurRDF's grammars, over the zero-dependency purrdf-hash root: the exact Turtle/SPARQL/XML/ECMA-262 character-class terminals and escape decoders, chunked byte-class scanners and needle searches that lower to packed compares, the RFC 8259 JSON string escaper and decoder, the JSON reader, value and deterministic writer, the YAML 1.2 reader and emitter, the RFC 8949 CBOR codec, RFC 6901 JSON Pointer tokens, RFC 3986 percent-encoding, Unicode normalization (NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD) as streaming stages, the RDF 1.2 term syntax with its IRI and literal escapers, an XML 1.0 + Namespaces reader, Crockford Base32, ordered association lists, and the heap work lists, iteratively dropped boxes and derive-exact Debug writer that deep trees walk with instead of the machine stack

packages.name: purrdf-stack
packages.description: How much stack the running thread has left — natively from the operating system's thread limit, on wasm32 from the shadow stack against an installable floor — and the margin the SPARQL evaluator refuses at instead of overflowing

packages.name: purrdf-testkit
packages.description: The workspace's shared test support: byte-exact golden files, temporary files and directories under the cargo target directory, self-hashing frozen differential vectors, a libtest-compatible runner for harness = false targets, and property-based testing on a recorded choice sequence, and a statistically sound micro-benchmark harness

packages.name: purrdf-xsd
packages.description: Native XSD value space (parse, value-space equality/ordering, canonical lexical mapping, SPARQL numeric promotion) for the RDF 1.2 query stack

packages.name: purrdf-deflate
packages.description: Native DEFLATE (RFC 1951) and gzip (RFC 1952) for PurRDF: a push-based streaming decoder, a deterministic encoder, and vector hot paths

packages.name: purrdf-datalog
packages.description: PurRDF native Datalog: deterministic wasm-clean semi-naive evaluation over a columnar relation store

packages.name: purrdf-entail
packages.description: PurRDF native entailment: wasm-clean RDF/RDFS/OWL 2 RL/D forward materialization over the RdfDataset IR, with a reasoning report on every closure

packages.name: purrdf-geo
packages.description: PurRDF GeoSPARQL 1.1: exact, float-free WKT/GeoJSON geometry and the geof: function family over the SPARQL extension seams

packages.name: purrdf-sparql-eval
packages.description: Native, RDF-1.2-first multiset SPARQL evaluator over the DatasetView read trait in interned TermId space — the runtime that consumes purrdf-sparql-algebra on the query path

packages.name: purrdf-sparql-algebra
packages.description: Native, wasm-clean SPARQL 1.1/1.2 parser → RDF 1.2-native query algebra AST (quoted triple terms, property paths, FILTER/BIND/VALUES, solution modifiers, GROUP BY) for the RDF 1.2 query stack

packages.name: purrdf-sparql-results
packages.description: Native, wasm-clean serializer for the SPARQL result model (SELECT/ASK/CONSTRUCT) to SPARQL Results JSON/XML/CSV/TSV plus a provenance-carrying purrdf extension — the canonical results-serialization authority

packages.name: purrdf-rdf
packages.description: PurRDF RDF 1.2 implementation: PyO3-free model, diagnostics, store traits, and native GTS/text-codec adapters

packages.name: purrdf-ed25519
packages.description: Native Ed25519 signatures (RFC 8032) for PurRDF: key expansion, deterministic signing over constant-time radix-2^51 field and Montgomery scalar arithmetic, and strict cofactorless verification that refuses non-canonical S, non-canonical point encodings and small-order keys and R

packages.name: purrdf-gts
packages.description: PurRDF GTS container engine: CBOR-sequence append-only graph transport reader, writer, folder, and verifier

packages.name: purrdf-jsonschema
packages.license: (MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR MulanPSL-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0
packages.description: Native JSON Schema validation for PurRDF: drafts 2020-12, 2019-09 and 07, every vocabulary, dynamic and recursive references, unevaluated keywords, standard output formats

packages.name: purrdf-shapes
packages.description: PurRDF SHACL validation engine core: native RDF 1.2 SHACL Core validator, gated against the SHACL conformance corpus

packages.name: purrdf-slice
packages.description: PurRDF native slice catalog: manifest-based discovery, typed artifact inventory, content-addressed IDs

packages.name: purrdf-hnsw
packages.description: Deterministic HNSW approximate nearest neighbor index for PurRDF

packages.name: purrdf-json
packages.description: Lossless ordered JSON to RDF 1.2: queryable occurrences over a verified verbatim byte cover

packages.name: purrdf-markdown
packages.description: PurRDF structural Markdown-to-RDF 1.2 slicer: a document becomes a graph of its own headings, verses, and paragraphs with verbatim byte spans, under a caller-supplied vocabulary and a declared, content-addressed profile.

packages.name: purrdf-retrieval
packages.description: Composition layer over the ranked property-function producers: pure-data retrieval plans with a canonical, domain-separated BLAKE3 identity, driven by caller-supplied producers, strata and weights with no fabricated default vocabulary.

packages.name: purrdf-text
packages.license: (MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR MulanPSL-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0
packages.description: Deterministic in-memory full-text search over RDF 1.2 literals, exposed to SPARQL through the property-function seam under caller-supplied IRIs; exact fixed-point BM25F ranking with no floating-point arithmetic.

packages.name: purrdf-shex
packages.description: PurRDF ShEx 2.1 engine: ShExC/ShExJ schema parsing, structural validation, and shape-map validation over the purrdf-core IR, gated against the shexTest conformance suite

packages.name: purrdf-validate
packages.description: PurRDF SARIF 2.1.0 reporting boundary: renders RDF diagnostics and SHACL/ShEx validation reports to source-traced, byte-deterministic SARIF — the boundary crate that keeps purrdf-core structured but SARIF-free

packages.name: purrdf-bench
packages.description: Benchmark tooling: the deterministic, shardable scale-corpus generator whose mixed IRI classes keep a capacity claim honest

packages.name: purrdf-cli
packages.description: PurRDF command-line interface: the `purrdf` convert/query/update/reason pipeline over the native codecs, pack container, SPARQL engine, and entailment closures

packages.name: purrdf-envelope-probe
packages.description: The micro-hardware envelope probe: runs the fixed small-deployment workload set over the public PurRDF APIs and reports allocator peaks, accounted bytes, and governor evidence per profile

packages.name: purrdf-hash-conformance
packages.description: Native frozen-vector conformance suites and benchmarks of purrdf-hash, with focused WebAssembly backend-selection and SIMD-kernel checks

packages.name: helper-census
packages.description: The structural helper census: finds isomorphic function bodies, repeated constants and hex tables across the PurRDF workspace and checks them against helpers-ledger.toml

packages.name: purrdf-capi
packages.description: PurRDF purrdf C-ABI: libpurrdf cdylib/staticlib over the purrdf semantic kernel

packages.name: purrdf-wasm
packages.description: purrdf: a wasm32, in-memory RDF 1.2 engine with an idiomatic RDF/JS (DataFactory/Dataset/Stream) API

packages.name: purrdf-sparql-conformance
packages.description: Native W3C SPARQL 1.0/1.1/1.2 conformance harness: discovers mf: test manifests, runs purrdf-sparql-eval, and compares expected SPARQL Results (SRX/SRJ), DAWG RDF result sets and canonical N-Quads. Federated SERVICE tests resolve through an in-memory RemoteQuerySource (no network).

packages.name: wasm-link
packages.description: The PurRDF wasm package's post-link rewriter: structural stack-pointer switching for the asynchronous lane and the poison gate, applied to the optimized module after wasm-opt

execution_window.clock: host wall clock; cross-runner synchronization is not independently certified
